title: Codex tracing: the root span identifies the agent with OpenTelemetry service.name set to 'codex'
answers: How does a Codex trace say which service or agent produced it?
Where is the service.name attribute set for Codex root spans?
Why does my Codex root span have a model attribute but no service name?
body:
Path: processNotify in libs/typescript/integrations/codex/src/tracing.ts handles each Codex notify payload (one conversation turn) and creates the root codex_conversation AGENT span carrying the user prompt, start time and model.
Rule: Put 'service.name' into the root span's attributes object next to model (attributes: { model, 'service.name': 'codex' }) so the trace identifies its emitting agent through the OpenTelemetry service.name key. Set it only on the root span; child spans are unchanged.
Constraints: Applies to the Codex integration's root span only. The Codex listing page (docs/docs/genai/tracing/integrations/listing/codex.mdx) and libs/typescript/integrations/codex/README.md document this value, so update them together if the name changes. The test 'sets the OpenTelemetry service name on the root span' in libs/typescript/integrations/codex/tests/tracing.test.ts asserts it.
applies: Codex TypeScript integration (libs/typescript/integrations/codex) root span creation; other integrations are not covered by this note.
says: The trace details view shows the model but does not identify the agent.
Conversation traces are missing the service name label in the telemetry dashboard.
Filter traces by agent name in the observability monitoring screen.
Add service identification to the root turn in the trace viewer.
search: In libs/typescript/integrations/codex/src/tracing.ts:processNotify, the root codex_conversation AGENT span must include 'service.name': 'codex' in its attributes object alongside model. This OpenTelemetry attribute identifies the emitting agent on root spans only, leaving child spans unchanged. If this value changes, update docs/docs/genai/tracing/integrations/listing/codex.mdx and libs/typescript/integrations/codex/README.md accordingly. This guidance applies exclusively to the Codex TypeScript integration root span and covers no other integrations.
